title: Read compatibility for normalized relative Proj twist transitions
statement: Given the chart isomorphisms and a normalized scalar-extension comparison for U ≤ V, with the chart square commuting and the chart preimages identified, the section-normalized transition map intertwines twistChartRead with restriction of sections of L.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to the normalized tensor-pullback adjunctions for the chart inclusion and transition. Evaluate on a section and use unit naturality for chart V. Substitute the equality of chart morphisms and evaluate the assumed chart square to identify the resulting composite with reading in chart U over the larger base open.

The composite of the normalized unit for chart U and chart U itself is a module morphism into the chart pushforward. Its presheaf naturality commutes with restricting the base open from V to U. The assumed equality of chart preimages identifies the resulting restriction with transport: the opens form a thin category, so after substituting their equality the restriction arrow is the identity. Combine this equality with the first calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem twist_chart_transition_read
    (L : A.relProj.Modules)
    (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
        Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1)
    (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).obj
          (Proj.twist (A.grading V) j) ≅ Proj.twist (A.grading U) j)
    (hθ : Proj.IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison (A.res h)
      (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h)) θ)
    (hsq :
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj L)
        (A.relProjFunctor_map_relProjι (homOfLE h)).symm) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionComp
          (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h)) (A.relProjι V)).app L ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).mapIso
          (chart V) ≪≫ θ 1 = chart U)
    (hopen : A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h) ⁻¹ᵁ A.twistChartOpen V =
      A.twistChartOpen U) :
    ∀ s : Γ(L, A.relProjHom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
      let t : Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1, A.twistChartOpen V) →+
          Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, A.twistChartOpen U) :=
        ConcreteCategory.hom
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction
              (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).unit.app
              (Proj.twist (A.grading V) 1)).app (A.twistChartOpen V) ≫
            (θ 1).hom.app
              (A.relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h) ⁻¹ᵁ A.twistChartOpen V) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg
              (fun W ↦ Γ(Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, W)) hopen))
      t (A.twistChartRead L chart V s) =
        A.twistChartRead L chart U
          (L.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map A.relProjHom.base).map
            (homOfLE (X := S.Opens) h)).op s)
